findings.location: …She snapped the paddle together, hopped into the seat, and pushed the kayak onto the smooth surface of the water.
findings.source_quote: She snapped the paddle together, hopped into the seat, and pushed the kayak onto the smooth surface of the water.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural or standard Korean term for "paddle" (노). Suggested replacement keeping HTML: "노를 조립하고 좌석에 올라타 연못의 고요한 물 위로 카약을 밀어 넣었다." Or include both terms if preferred: "패들을(노를) 조립하고…"
findings.translation_quote: 패들을 조립하고 좌석에 올라타 연못의 고요한 물 위로 카약을 밀어 넣었다.
